title: Ferric
subtitle: Iron, barbs, certainty
text: Ferric tendency is solidity and unchanging resolve. It manifests as iron-hard growths, barbs, and rigid constructs. Blood drawn through mineral certainty remembers the permanence of stone and tries to impose that permanence on everything it touches. Ferric-tended Hemomancers are often described as immovable — not slow, but absolute. Their blood has decided. It does not reconsider.
